subject.title: fix(feishu): upgrade single newlines to paragraph breaks in post md messages

question: Should this Feishu newline candidate remain blocked until live Feishu/Lark proof is attached, or should maintainers provide or accept another proof path for this branch?
rationale: The source-level fix is plausible and prior code findings appear addressed, but generated payload output does not prove the Feishu/Lark client rendering or live delivery behavior that the bug is about.

options.title: Require live proof before merge
options.body: Keep this branch open but blocked until a redacted Feishu/Lark screenshot, recording, API transcript, or log from this branch shows corrected rendering and near-limit delivery.

options.title: Maintainer runs sandbox proof
options.body: If the contributor lacks tenant credentials, a maintainer can run the proof in a sandbox tenant and attach the redacted artifact before merge.

options.title: Choose a proof-positive sibling
options.body: If maintainers prefer another open candidate after it is conflict-free and proof-positive, designate that PR as canonical and close the remaining candidates afterward.

recommendation.title: Require live proof before merge
recommendation.body: Keep this branch open but blocked until a redacted Feishu/Lark screenshot, recording, API transcript, or log from this branch shows corrected rendering and near-limit delivery.
